def test_ccode_sinc():
    from sympy import sinc
    expr = sinc(x)
    assert ccode(expr) == (
            "((x != 0) ? (\n"
            "   sin(x)/x\n"
            ")\n"
            ": (\n"
            "   1\n"
            "))")


def test_ccode_Piecewise_deep():
    p = ccode(2*Piecewise((x, x < 1), (x + 1, x < 2), (x**2, True)))
    assert p == (
            "2*((x < 1) ? (\n"
            "   x\n"
            ")\n"
            ": ((x < 2) ? (\n"
            "   x + 1\n"
